nom: Rael Miracle Clear Brightening Triple Acid Exfoliant

segments.dry: Reviewers with drier skin report some dry patches remained after a short application and suggest a longer leave-on time might work better for their skin type.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one who also describes it as sensitive, report smoother skin and lightened sun or age spots, alongside some dry patches and a caution to wear sunscreen afterward.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who describe sensitive skin report no irritation, burning or redness even after a few days of use and call it gentle enough to start with as a beginner acid exfoliant; one reviewer bought it specifically because it was marketed for sensitive skin but found it burned her skin instead.

concerns.spots: Reviewers with hyperpigmentation, melasma, sun spots or acne-related dark spots and scarring report visible fading and a more even tone after consistent use, generally within two to four weeks; no reviewer in this set reports spots worsening.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe acne-prone or persistently acne-affected skin, including hormonal acne, report the exfoliant did not cause new breakouts and in some cases improved existing acne and related discoloration.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no lasting redness or irritation, several describing only a brief sting or tingle that fades; one reviewer reports the product burned her skin despite being marketed for sensitive skin, and did not see it help her skin overall.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report skin feels soft, smooth and sometimes more hydrated after use; two reviewers with drier skin found dry patches remained after a short application, suggesting the product may need longer contact time or lighter use for very dry skin.

aspects.libelle: Gel-like texture, easy to apply precisely
Must be rinsed off rather than left on
Strength can feel intense for beginners

extraits.texte: I wanted to try this as it was advertised for sensitive skin. After a few weeks of using it, I noticed it didnt really do much for my skin, and actually quite honestly burned my skin. I dont think this product is good for sensitive skin.

Real kindly gave me this Miracle Clear Brightening Triple Acid Exfoliant for free so that I could review it. I am familiar with using acids as exfoliators and I much prefer that method over physical exfoliators, so I do really love when I see an affordable option, which this is. I think this would be a great beginner acid exfoliator because, in my experience, it felt gentle on the skin, compared to others I have tried. I did notice that it helped in making my skin appear softer and more bright; however, I actually still had some dry patches after the 3 minute mask, so leaving it on for longer might be a better option for drier skin, like I have. I struggled with a rating because I believe this should really be a good 3 1/2 stars - it's a good exfoliant, and I would recommend it to someone who is just beginning to try chemical exfoliators or is seeking a gentler method of exfoliation, but I don't think it's the best I've tried. I also prefer to use wipes or cotton pads/liquid rather than a mask and I will more regularly use that over a mask. That being said, I will continue to use this product and would still recommend this to certain people that fit within certain parameters because I do think it is a pretty good product at a great price.

extraits.titre: Great Triple Acid Exfoliant that treats dark spots
extraits.texte: Great product for an at-home facial that instantly provides a brighter looking skin. Leaves your skin feeling softer, smoother, and radiant looking. Great innovative triple acid complex, consisting of AHA, BHA, and PHA. This powerful blend optimally exfoliates the skin, while enhancing cell turnover to correct an uneven skin tone and reduce the appearance of dark spots. Also, contains much needed hyaluronic acid which delivers immediate hydration. This product is ideal for my needs since I have dark spots from hyperpigmentation and melasma.

I've used a ton of similar products on my acne-prone skin, and this is definitely a nice exfoliant. I like that it's a gel texture rather than liquid, and that it doesn't sting my skin, even when I leave it on for 10 minutes. It does make my skin softer and a bit more glowy after use, although it is not the most powerful exfoliant I've tried. I think this is a really good option for people with more sensitive skin who may not be able to tolerate more extreme products.

First of all, the packing of this product is really nice. I love to have exfoliant product is in the pump bottle like this to keep the quality of the product also easy to manage the amount of product be used. The texture of this exfoliation is not liquid like water but have thicker texture like serum but easy to absorb on your skin. The smell is not really nice, which is fair enough with product contain high amout of acid but I think it is not big issue at all. To the main point, I have used this product for about a week and see instantly the improvement on my blackhead on nose. The feeling of apply this product on your skin might cause little itchy but do not worry because it will disappear after few mins. My skin is kinda sensitive but after 3 days continually using it, it is not appear any sign of inflation or redness. Therefore, I believe this product is nice for sensitive skin. Overall, this product worth try if you have the issue on your pore and acnes.

Rael Miracle Clear made my skin baby soft after using it regularly. I have an extensive am/pm skin care routine and I added it to my pm routine 4 nights a week. I left on the liquid exfoliant for about 5 minutes and then removed it to reveal baby soft skin. I love that it's a Kbeauty product and dermatologist tested and vegan and cruelty free. I use(d) other popular liquid exfoliants, and I really like the triple action of this product vs the single property of the others. This is going to become a staple in my routine! It's gentle enough for regular use,for my skin type. I have normal combination skin with some small,stubborn sun/age spots on my cheek and I could see a slight lightening of the spot, and also just an overall brightening of my face.

extraits.titre: Amazing Product that Absorbs In Minutes
extraits.texte: I would absolutely recommend this product. I suffer from adult acne and acne scarring. I have been able to see a difference in the appearance of my skin. I am also very sensitive and so far, I have not had an allergic reaction. Always a win!!
